summary: Validated nav change on PublicHome: removed 'Nosotros'/'Contacto' and added 'Mapa' link that scrolls to #cartera and activates map view. Desktop and mobile both pass core requirements. One minor UX concern on the mobile icon rendering.

issues: The icon next to 'Mapa' uses lucide 'MapPinned' at 15x15 which, at that small size and alongside other menu items, visually resembles a person/user silhouette (user explicitly warned against this). Consider using lucide 'Map' icon instead for clearer semantics.

test_results_detail.click_mapa_activates_map_view: YES - 'Ver en mapa' toggle is-active, Google Map rendered with pins

action_items: Consider swapping lucide 'MapPinned' icon for lucide 'Map' in the nav-mapa button (both desktop and mobile) — the current icon at small sizes can read like a user/person icon, which the user explicitly flagged. Not a blocker.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav change verified fully on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). All functional requirements met. Only outstanding note is the mobile icon choice for 'Mapa'. /web and /web/{id} were not re-tested as instructed.
